assessment: A-level tool-first page for "title tag checker" (210/mo, KD 9): the Title Tag Checker is the first screen, the 50-word answer resolves the query directly, and the body answers "title tag check", "meta description checker", "check meta description" with first-hand AEOeye measurements before handing off to the free SEO audit.

topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "title tag checker" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.

sources.supports: No limit on title element length; title links truncated to fit the device width.
No limit on meta description length; snippets truncated to fit the device; description used when it describes the page better.
Title elements used around 87% of the time after the 2021 change (up from ~80%).
AEOeye 391-site baseline: redirects, headers, meta tags, OG/X tags, icons, JSON-LD, image formats, blog location, soft 404s.

checks: Re-read every factual claim against the cited primary sources, fetched on 2026-10-24 (4 sources listed on the page); unverifiable statements were removed or reworded before publishing.
content-lint passed with no errors: 400 words, 2 Pexels images, 3 inline source links, 3 internal links, 4 FAQs, 5 H2 sections.
Title/H1, secondary-keyword H2s and meta description match the locked three-round plan in docs/seo-v2/final-table.json.
Rendered on the local build at a 375 px mobile viewport: no horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth equals the viewport width).
Recomputed every figure quoted from AEOeye Technical SEO Baseline (391 sites, 2026-10-24) from the raw files in /public/resources.
Exercised the SERP editor (pixel meters) in the browser on the local build at desktop and 375 px widths.
